The '''Administrator's Palace''' was a 56-story high building located in center of the upper plaza of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. It was the home of the [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]], as well as the [[Figg & Associates]] offices and [[Parliament of Guilds]].
